_meta.title: evgt Universal 13 IDs - Cluster Fingerprints
_meta.method: Cross-save correlation of int2/int3 values for IDs present in all 10 saves
_meta.finding: int2 and int3 are Unix timestamps. Three behavioral groups identified.

group_a.pattern: int2 == int3 (single timestamp), all five share same timestamp per save
group_a.hypothesis: Batch of tutorial/onboarding system events completed at account creation

group_b.pattern: int2 = start timestamp, int3 = 0 (incomplete) in 8/10 saves
group_b.hypothesis: Multi-day event chain. 0 = not yet completed.

patterns.9001: int2 != int3, spans days to months (long-running?)
patterns.123463: int2 != int3, varies widely per save

group_c.hypothesis: Varied event types with different duration semantics

refined_semantics.confidence: STRONGLY SUPPORTED - timestamps are real Unix times, patterns consistent across 10 saves
